operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a paginated list of leave applications for the account. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not a page number. Pagination is controlled by the `page` and `per_page` query parameters.

Results can be scoped to an approval tab with the `status` query parameter; when it is omitted the request is redirected so that `status=all` is applied by default.

| Parameter | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `page` | Page number (default `1`). |
| `per_page` | Items per page (default `20`). |
| `status` | Approval tab to list. One of `all`, `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `pending_on_me`. Defaults to `all`. |
| `filter[<field>][<operator>]` | Filter by a field, e.g. `filter[staff_id][equal]=1`. |
| `sort[<field>]` | Sort by a field, `asc` or `desc`. |
| `fields[]` | Restrict the returned columns. |
| `search` | Free-text search. |

**Filterable fields.** Filter with `filter[<field>][<operator>]=<value>`. The fields intended for filtering:

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | `filter[id][equal]=5` |
| `staff_id` | integer (staff) | `filter[staff_id][equal]=1` |
| `type` | enum (`leave`, `half_leave`, `delay`, `early`) | `filter[type][equal]=leave` |
| `date_from` | date | `filter[date_from][greater_than_equal]=2026-01-01` |
| `date_to` | date | `filter[date_to][less_than_equal]=2026-12-31` |
| `created` | datetime | `filter[created][greater_than_equal]=2026-01-01` |
| `approved_by` | integer (staff) | `filter[approved_by][equal]=3` |
| `shift_type` | enum (`primary`, `secondary`) | `filter[shift_type][equal]=primary` |

Filter by approval state with the `status` tab parameter (above), not `filter[status]`. In practice the endpoint accepts a filter on any existing column.

**Sortable fields.** Sort with `sort[<field>]=asc|desc`. The field intended for sorting:

| Field | Type | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `created` | datetime | `sort[created]=desc` |

When no `sort` is given, results are returned newest-first (by `id`, descending). In practice the endpoint accepts a sort on any existing field.

The response is a standard paginated envelope; each item in `data` is a leave-application record. Which staff members' applications are returned depends on the caller's leave permissions (own applications, or those they may view/approve for others).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Approval tab to list: `all`, `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, or `pending_on_me`. Defaults to `all`.

200.description: A paginated list of leave applications.

data.description: The leave applications on this page. Each item is a leave-application record.

staff_id.description: Id of the staff member the leave is for.

created_by.description: Id of the staff member who created the application.

400.description: The list could not be produced — for example the leave-application entity is unavailable for this account or the required plugin is inactive.

error.description: Reason the request failed (e.g. the leave-application entity is unavailable for the account, or the required plugin is not active).

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.
